# Windows Packaging
This directory contains the helper script for building a custom runtime image with `jlink` and a Windows installer with `jpackage`.
## Prerequisites
- JDK 26 with `jlink` and `jpackage` available on `PATH` or via `JAVA_HOME` - Maven 3.9+ - Windows 10/11
## Full build
From the repository root:
```powershell .\packaging\windows\build-installer.ps1 ```
The script will:
1. Build the Maven modules. 2. Copy runtime dependencies for `ui-javafx`. 3. Stage the application JAR plus dependencies. 4. Build a custom runtime image with `jlink`. 5. Package a Windows installer with `jpackage`.
The installer is written to:
```text ui-javafx\target\packaging\installer ```
## Prepare-only mode
If you want to verify the staging logic without invoking `jlink`/`jpackage`, use:
```powershell .\packaging\windows\build-installer.ps1 -SkipMaven -PrepareOnly ```
This is useful for quick checks when the build artifacts already exist.
## Maven profile
The `ui-javafx` module provides a `windows-installer` profile that copies runtime dependencies into:
```text ui-javafx\target\packaging\runtime-libs ```
Use it together with the script when you want a reproducible packaging layout.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd"> <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
<parent> <groupId>com.github.uscexp</groupId> <artifactId>jFileWork</artifactId> <version>0.0.1-Alpha-SNAPSHOT</version> </parent>
<artifactId>jfilework-ui-javafx</artifactId> <name>jFileWork — UI (JavaFX)</name> <description>JavaFX dual-pane UI: split view, menus, toolbar, keybindings and dialogs.</description>
<dependencies> <!-- Internal --> <dependency> <groupId>com.github.uscexp</groupId> <artifactId>jfilework-core</artifactId> </dependency>
<!-- JavaFX --> <dependency> <groupId>org.openjfx</groupId> <artifactId>javafx-controls</artifactId> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>org.openjfx</groupId> <artifactId>javafx-fxml</artifactId> </dependency>
<!-- Logging --> <dependency> <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId> <artifactId>slf4j-api</artifactId> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>ch.qos.logback</groupId> <artifactId>logback-classic</artifactId> </dependency>
<!-- Test --> <dependency> <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId> <artifactId>junit-jupiter-api</artifactId> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>org.testfx</groupId> <artifactId>testfx-core</artifactId> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>org.testfx</groupId> <artifactId>testfx-junit5</artifactId> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>org.testfx</groupId> <artifactId>openjfx-monocle</artifactId> </dependency> <dependency> <groupId>com.github.uscexp</groupId> <artifactId>jfilework-sample-hash-plugin</artifactId> <scope>test</scope> </dependency> </dependencies>
<build> <plugins> <!-- JavaFX launcher: mvn javafx:run --> <plugin> <groupId>org.openjfx</groupId> <artifactId>javafx-maven-plugin</artifactId> <version>${javafx.maven.plugin.version}</version> <configuration> <mainClass>com.github.uscexp.jfilework.ui.javafx.MainLauncher</mainClass> </configuration> </plugin>
<!-- Surefire: headless JavaFX tests via Monocle --> <plugin> <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId> <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId> <configuration> <argLine> --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED -Dglass.platform=Monocle -Dmonocle.platform=Headless -Dprism.order=sw -Dprism.text=t2k -Dheadless.geometry=1600x1200-32 -Dtestfx.robot=glass -Dtestfx.headless=true </argLine> </configuration> </plugin> </plugins> </build> </project>
